notes.title: [IMPORTANT] For those with integrated graphics cards...
notes.content:
The WebGL AttachShader error that some players are reporting is a problem that can occur with computers using integrated graphics. However, there is a workaround.

[h1]Step 1[/h1]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29248535/10054cdccff843337f8bb0e5dd2a32421772413b.jpg[/img]
Right-click on the game in your Steam Library, and select properties.

[h1]Step 2[/h1]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29248535/275bc33318fc6ddab4ffbd2c1d270bc180e59e78.png[/img]
Select the Betas tab, and choose "integratedgraphicsmode"

[h1]Step 3[/h1]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29248535/c94ddc93b355394c6035d89f784ef9b687e122c6.png[/img]
Allow the game to install the IG version, and you've done it!

Please note that features such as achievements will not function in integrated graphics mode.
